package.note: Three of the four check bugs are fixed in site-runtime 0.67.1 and proven. D1: the check sends a Chrome agent; on the devkit runner (run 41252992440, 1 Nov 00:10 UTC, check v0.67.1) D1 passes on all ten custom domains and fails only on txasm and bsw (workers.dev, accepted); curl with that agent gets 103 then 200 on all ten. B4: a 404 is judged by its cache-control; passes on Carrel, Capsomer, Enarratio, Prelum and the explorer (no B4 in the run). hashed(): needs a hash-like token; apple-touch-icon.png is no longer hashed (4 unit tests pass). Still wrong: the old path shortcut in hashed() treats every file under /assets/ or /islands/ as hashed, so C1 fails 5 times on the Capsid explorer, whose /assets files (capsomer.css, enarratio.css, explorer.css, theme.js, explorer.js) are deliberately unhashed (explorer/worker.mjs says so) and send public, max-age=3600, which is right for them. Until the check judges those by their names, or the explorer hashes them, the board stays red on that cell. A1/A3 have no data without the CrUX key (Dustin's; the run shows PageSpeed 429). Not caught in round 2 because a cloud session's Node cannot decode zstd, so the home page body was empty and no files were sampled.
